description.value:
You can extend your Ranger's Quarry feature to cover a 10-foot cube within 60 feet that you can see, treating every creature inside as if marked; whenever one of them is hit by a tech attack or fails a save against a damaging tech power you cast, you may apply your Ranger's Quarry damage to it.

At 11th level, this cube grows to 15 feet on a side.
